---
title: "World Cup 2026 — Fixtures Refresh"
output: html_document
---

This document is deployed to POSIT Connect as a **scheduled R Markdown**.
Each scheduled render pulls fresh fixtures + results from football-data.org
and writes them to the `wc26_fixtures` pin shared with the interactive app.

Schedule on Connect: typically `*/10 * * * *` during match windows, hourly
otherwise.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r run-refresh}
# Run from the same directory as this .Rmd so source() paths resolve.
source("refresh_job.R")
```

Rendered at `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z", tz = "UTC")`.
